intro.lead: Since our founding in 2018 we have implemented 13 approved projects with a total value of around €225,000, from green initiatives with schools and children to European partnerships in which we lead work packages.

flagship.tag: ERASMUS+ KA2 · ADULT EDUCATION · IN PROGRESS 2025–2027
flagship.title: Adapt & Solve
flagship.lead: Our largest current project: an international partnership in which KORAK leads the entire work package of educator training and pilot implementation (WP3) and co-leads WP4.
flagship.desc: The project empowers low-skilled adults (aged 25–55) for adaptive problem solving in everyday life, at work and in the digital environment, while also strengthening the competences of adult educators. KORAK designs the educator toolkit, organises the educator training in Dubrovnik, coordinates the pilot trainings and leads the feedback analysis.
flagship.partners: JumpIN Hub (Portugal, coordinator) · Curaçao Informatica Stimuleringsplan · Charisma (Poland) · KORAK (Croatia)
results: The Think, Act, Solve handbook for adaptive problem solving
An educator toolkit designed by KORAK
4 interactive playlists (Cities of Learning) and 16 digital badges
Educator training (LTTA) in Dubrovnik for 8 educators
Pilot trainings with 80 adult participants in 4 countries
